source_caption:
Margaret Qualley gives Once Upon a Time in Hollywood a strange, hypnotic energy as Pussycat. Her scenes with Brad Pitt work because she feels playful and dangerous at the same time — a symbol of the film’s shifting 1969 atmosphere, where Hollywood nostalgia and real menace start to blur.

Once Upon a Time in Hollywood (2019), directed by Quentin Tarantino, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Brad Pitt, Margot Robbie. A stylish and nostalgic journey through 1969 Los Angeles, blending fading stardom, friendship, and Hollywood mythology into one of Tarantino’s most atmospheric films.

source_details.synopsis: Once Upon a Time... in Hollywood is a 2019 comedy-drama film written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, who produced it with David Heyman and Shannon McIntosh. Produced by Columbia Pictures in association with Bona Film Group, Heyday Films, and Visiona Romantica, and distributed by Sony Pictures Releasing, it is a co-production between the United States, United Kingdom, and China. It features an ensemble cast led by Leonardo DiCaprio as Rick Dalton, an aging Western hero; Brad Pitt as his stunt double Cliff Booth; and Margot Robbie as actress Sharon Tate, wife of Roman Polanski.
